title: clypeola jonthlaspi proles hispida
intro: Clypeola jonthlaspi proles hispida, commonly known as  Shephard's Needle or Shepherd's Needle, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Shepherd's Needle include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions such as indigestion and urinary disorders. The bioactive constituents of Shepherd's Needle include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
